## Checklist

- [ ] Tests added or updated (`composer test`)
- [ ] `composer lint` and `composer analyse` pass
- [ ] Both translations (ar, en) updated when texts changed
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` (Unreleased) and the relevant page in `docs/` updated
- [ ] No secret, key or personal data in code, tests or logs
